summary: Allarity Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce its presentation of a Trial-in-Progress poster at the ESMO Gynaecological Cancers Congress 2026 regarding its Phase 2 stenoparib trial in ovarian cancer. The filing is a routine disclosure of a scientific conference presentation, not a special situation. No terms, stakes, premiums, or structural changes are provided. There are no deal mechanics, board recommendations, or risk-arb angles.
